title: structured-output: add tokenizer unicode/regression fallbacks and improve regex/CFG constrained backends
author: Priya Singh
description: Motivation: constrained decoding backends (CFG and regex-based) have regressed on a class of tokenizer edgecases involving unicode grapheme clusters and lookahead when combined with regex constraints. This causes malformed structured outputs and degrades streaming stability for long-running chat sessions. This PR provides a backwards-compatible fallback path that: 1) detects tokenizer split points that break regex/CFG token boundaries, 2) applies a normalization+grapheme-aware re-tokenization before constraint checking, and 3) adds a targeted retry/fallback to the CFG walker when tokenization mismatches are detected. Changeset summary: - Add tokenizer unicode fallback and normalization layer in tokenizer/tokenizer_utils.py - Update constrained decoding backends to call tokenizer-aware boundary checks before applying regex/CFG constraints - Add a small deterministic retry path that attempts character-level CFG matching as a last resort to preserve structured output correctness - Add extensive unit/regression tests and a small benchmark harness to measure latency regression risk - Minor OpenAI-compatibility header fix in redwood-openai-compat to ensure constrained outputs maintain same newline semantics as OpenAI responses Checklist: - [x] Implementation and unit tests - [x] Integration tests for OpenAI-compat layer - [x] Performance microbenchmark (no >5% median latency regression on typical payloads) - [x] Docs update and changelog entry Related: ENG-4821 tracks remaining tokenizer canonicalization work and SUP-1123 is the support ticket that surfaced the issue.

review_comments: Samir Rao: The fallback path looks good, but can we avoid an extra allocation on the hot path? Suggest in-place normalization where possible.

Priya Singh (reply): Switched to in-place NFC normalization for bytes-compatible tokenizers; added a microbenchmark to show allocations are negligible in realistic workloads and a guard to bypass normalization when tokenizer reports stable boundaries.
Elena Kim: Tests are comprehensive, but please add a case with mixed RTL + emoji sequences (we've seen this in SUP-1123).
Priya Singh (reply): Added mixed RTL+emoji regression case and a note in the docs describing tokenizer caveats.
Jack Liu: The retry path could mask upstream CFG bugs. Can you add metrics and a feature flag to disable retries for now?
Priya Singh (reply): Added a feature flag `CONSTRAINED_DECODING_CHAR_FALLBACK` (default on) and exposed a metrics counter `constrained_decoding.fallback_count`.
Samir Rao: CI flake on linux-integration; reran and all checks passed. Approved.

release_notes: Fix: structured output constrained decoding now correctly handles tokenizer unicode/grapheme edgecases and falls back to character-level CFG matching when needed. This prevents malformed structured outputs for sequences containing complex unicode (emoji, ZWJ sequences, RTL+emoji). Added feature flag to disable char-level fallback and metrics to monitor fallback frequency.
